# Design guidance

For UI implementation or design-guidance changes, use the [design-system skill](../skills/design-system/SKILL.md) to find the relevant principles, component specification, and implementation workflow. This instruction supplies the automatic entry point for matching files; the skill and the documents it links to own the guidance.
